answer: The plume is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the oasis. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
